◉ IRIS — Intelligent Realism & Image Synthesis — v1.8

IRIS NAME RECONCILIATION 003
Build identity: IRIS v1.8 / Name Reconciliation 003 / 2026-09-23
Date: 2026-09-23

DECISION
IRIS.FORGE → REMOVE AS ACTIVE INTERNAL IDENTITY
Temporary IRIS.FOUNDRY replacement → REMOVE
Global EDEN FORGE → UNCHANGED

INSPECTION EVIDENCE
The latest packaged IRIS implementation defined the temporary FOUNDRY role as constructing render-ready scene specifications and building subject, environment, composition, camera, lighting, materials, condition, scale references, physical interactions and negative constraints. Those functions fall within retained IRIS visual intelligence/generation/rendering responsibilities and overlap existing IRIS Compiler, Fusion, Calibration, generation and QA stages. The implementation did not establish a necessary independent deterministic worker boundary. Therefore the stop-deletion condition was not met.

RESULT
No local replacement worker is created. Visual scene/specification work remains within IRIS's existing visual pipeline. Deterministic technical processing/tooling is delegated to global EDEN FORGE through the EDEN capability/provider relationship.

HISTORICAL PROVENANCE
Earlier IRIS.FORGE → IRIS.FOUNDRY migration records are retained as superseded historical provenance only.
